text:
Maya: quick thought — what if we add a 'semantic healthguard' that can auto-fallback based on quality signals, not just latency/errors?
Tom: interesting. which quality signals are you thinking? factuality, safety, hallucination rate?
Maya: yep. prototype idea: sample ~1% of live requests and run a lightweight evaluator on a rotating set of golden prompts + tenant seeds. keep a rolling score; if it drops below a threshold, flip routing to a safe variant.
Rachel: product +1 if this prevents bad customer-facing outputs. define 'safe variant' for me. smaller model? decoding changes?
Maya: safe variant = deterministic decoding + smaller quantized model + strict post-filtering. aim is to lower risk while keeping latency close to normal.
Tom: evaluator cost is a worry. sync vs async?
Maya: async. we won't block responses. evaluator writes rolling-window metrics; router subscribes and flips when policy triggers.
Kevin: need window and hysteresis to avoid flapping. also false positives on bursts.
Maya: sketch: window=5m, min_samples=50, trigger if median(score)<0.72 AND p95_drop>0.12, cooldown=10m.
Tom: evaluator could be a tiny distil model on CPU to keep cost down.
Maya: exactly — distil evaluator hosted on dedicated infra; a few seconds of lag is fine.
Rachel: how do we pick golden prompts? users are diverse.
Maya: two-tier prompts: (1) curated per-domain golden prompts in console (curated by Eng-ML + Product), (2) tenant-specific seeds derived from opt-in anonymized recent traffic.
Tom: signals are noisy — propose combining them: combined = alpha*semantic + beta*safety_count + gamma*latency_penalty.
Maya: example config:
```
{"alpha":0.7, "beta":0.2, "gamma":0.1, "threshold":0.65}
```
Tom: how does this interact with existing canary/A-B logic? duplicate triggers?
Maya: precedence: infra errors > latency SLOs > semantic healthguard > manual. semantic guard shouldn't hijack when canary share > 30% unless labeled.
Kevin: ops: who curates golden prompts? SRE needs visibility/edit rights?
Rachel: propose shared curation (Eng-ML + Product). tenants can opt into adding seeds.
Tom: observability: dashboard per-route with eval score trend, sample count, last triggered fallback, and redacted sample diffs. also attach model vs safe-variant diffs.
Maya: console changes: 'Semantic Health' card, traffic marker when routing flipped, and a force-unflip button.
Kevin: emergency kill-switch? force immediate fallback across regions?
Maya: include manual override + auto-escalation to oncall if >3 auto-switches in 24h.
Tom: adversarial inputs could game evaluator. add randomness in prompt selection and rotate golden set to reduce overfitting.
Maya: also periodically validate evaluator against an offline eval set to detect drift.
Rachel: rollout plan for this feature?
Maya: RFC -> internal pilot with one non-critical model and few tenants -> expand after false-positive rate <2% and extra cost <5% of inference spend.
Kevin: TODOs:
- Tom: prototype distil evaluator + healthExpression API (2w)
- Maya: router change for semantic flip policy + cooldown (1w)
- Rachel: UI card + opt-in flow (1w)
- Ops: run pilot & collect metrics (3w)
Tom: health events will be emitted to eventbus as: semantic.health.<model>.<region> with payload {score, samples, reason} — rate-limit and scrub payloads.
Maya: tie switch events to incident-bot if tenant_impact >5% traffic.
Tom: when flip occurs, shadow traffic to safe variant for 30s before fully cutting over to gather diff telemetry.
Kevin: adding this to the oncall playbook and postmortem checklist.
Maya: I'll draft a lightweight RFC with config schema, dashboard mockups, and a pilot checklist. ping me if you want in.
Rachel: thanks all :thumbsup:
eval-bot: scheduled evaluator deployed to staging at 2024-11-07T15:12:00Z (build 0.3.1)
